The '''Waters of the Primal Destroyer''' was the name given to the shallow lake in the [[Ancient Stasis Zone]] of [[the Tomb]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It earned the name after the [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] known as the [[Primal Destroyer]] was released during the [[invasion of Belsavis]] and made its home in the shallow lake.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Waters of the Primal Destroyer appears as a Heroic Area on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''; it is the site of the planet's World Boss, the Primal Destroyer.<ref name="TOR" />
